title: Bot entry
description: An entry a DCA bot writes to the ledger (decision 0016, slice L2), as the payload of a journal row (journal-row.schema.json). The order engine's fold skips these; the runtime folds them, with the order engine's steps each bot heard, back into its bots. Times are milliseconds since the epoch on the runtime's wall clock; prices and sizes are decimal strings. Mirrors src/runtime/store/store.ts, BotEntry; the reducer's inputs are src/domain/dca/live.ts, BotInput.

request.description: Who asked for a command and under which id (decision 0010 d3, d4): the journaled command is its durable request row. principal is person, hook:<id>, key:<id>, link:<id> or runtime; hash is the SHA-256 of the body's canonical JSON; actor as the API derived it (a trading key's, B80: {kind: key, keyId, counted}, counted the quote its command counts against the key's 24 hours).

oneOf.title: Bot input
oneOf.description: One input of the bot's reducer that is not an order-engine step: create (with its settings, dca-bot-create.schema.json, the tick it starts from, and on spot `coinFee`, added for ruling 151), command, timer, allowance (the requests left on the account's allowance; `walletUntil`, added for B61, when the account's API wallet expires, absent when not known), position (the account's, the switch on), liquidation (`size` the bot's share, zero for a bot the split does not charge; `whole` the fill's size and `order` the liquidation order's id, both added in L2), venue-flat (the exchange flat on two healthy reads), funding (B64: the bot's share of one funding payment, `usdc` paid negative, `id` the coin and the venue's hour, booked once), released (added 2026-10-03, 0003b d12: its account was removed from gcx; the bot is done as it stands, nothing cancelled or closed, RULINGS 23: stopped, or with `cause` account, added 2026-10-10 for 0003b amendment 3, error with the reason Account removed; an older build ignores it, or reads it without its cause), pause (added 2026-10-04, ruling 73 (a): the trading key that created the bot was suspended or revoked, `on` true, or resumed, `on` false; an older build ignores it), recheck (added 2026-10-04, ruling 170 (b): the runtime's ledger shows room in the trading key's limits for a bot they alone hold; the bot enters as any due cycle does, counted again; an older build ignores it, the bot then waits for Retry as it did), wallet (added 2026-10-04, ruling 164 (b): a fresh read of the account's API wallet giving it more than a day, after a renewal, `walletUntil` its expiry as on allowance; a bot waiting in repair wallet-expiring resumes; an older build ignores it), differs (added 2026-10-05, decision 0016 Amendment 2: the runtime found, on two trusted reads 90 s apart, that the exchange's signed position on the coin, `exchange`, differs from the sum of the bots' records there since `since`, the last agreement, `cause` the likely one (liquidation, gcx, outside, none); with `agrees` true a trusted read agrees again and the item closes; written only for bots with "Only gcx trades this coin" on; an older build ignores it), reattach (added 2026-10-05, RULINGS 202 (b): a healthy read shows the exchange holding on the bot's side again while legs of its cycle's take-profit and stop-loss are gone with an earlier position; the bot makes them again, switch on or off, with no item open; an older build ignores it, the bot then runs without those exits as it did), correction (added 2026-10-06, decision 0028 d23: after an adopt whose rebuilt count does not reach the bot's share, what the fills did not reach: `was` and `now` the cycle's {size, cost} before and after, folded by now − was, `price` the figure used (the exchange's entry, or the bot's average), `pnl` "0", `between` {from, to} the bracket of the difference, `cause` unexplained or below-minimum, `reach` the oldest time the venue's history served when it did not reach the cycle's start; an older build ignores it and keeps its own cost), foreign (added 2026-10-06, decision 0028 d26: the yellow notice's facts with "Only this bot trades this pair" on, `fills` [{id, at, side, size, price}] on the pair not this bot's, `orders` [{id, side, size, price}] resting at the exchange not this bot's, `exchange` the figure of a trusted read when one was made; one episode from its first row to the row with `clear` true; it holds nothing; an older build ignores it), claim-released (added 2026-10-09, ruling 406 b: a fresh trusted read showed the account flat on the coin of a bot stopped without closing that still claims a part of it; the bot lets go of it for good, holding nothing, its P&L, cycle and end as they were, nothing sent; a bot not done ignores it; an older build ignores it, the bot keeping its claim), run (added 2026-10-20, decision 0006 amendment 1 d3: nothing held the bot's coin's trades any more, so the price it heard says nothing about later; `at` is strictly after the last price it heard, and the bot prices nothing until a price of this run, as after a start; an older build folds it the same, through the bot's reducer) or step: a tick the bot heard before a step because its own was older than the runtime's. Since 0028: differs carries `first` (the first read that differed, d24); the command kind keep ("Bot is right" on a red item, "Accept" on the yellow notice: the switch off, nothing sent); differs adopt carries `rebuild` {fills, was, now} (d22.7: the fills no bot's order made that the rebuild counted, and the cycle's figures at the press and rebuilt; the fold moves each by now − was; `share`, `was` and `price` stay for an older build); modify carries `wholePosition`, applied at once. Since 0017 A1: signal is an additive authoritative nonempty condition list with both legacy TA arrays explicitly empty; one atomic Modify carries all three fields, signal:null restores single TA; accepted arms remain facts. Since 0016 Amendment 7 (MH 669): modify carries `taPeriods` and `taSignals`, and its `from` is written exactly when a field waited for the next cycle (a cycle open at the press); an older build folds both the same. Since 0016 Amendment 9: the command kind modify-clear sets maxCycles, endAt, atEnd, slPct or slEnabled and removes maxCycles, endAt (with atEnd) or slLossPct (`clear`), the only command that sets or moves the end; an older build ignores it.

entryConditions.description: E5: optional facts captured when a TA arm is accepted, before allowance. Side is pre-Inverse. Absent on old arms means no condition detail; never inferred from current settings. Previous builds ignore this additive field.

account.description: A2 d61: held account value on allowance or d100(b) leverage input; null before a value has ever been held; no send-time or replay read

scale.description: A2 d69 / d100(b): the resolved cycle factor on allowance or leverage; old leverage rows without it remain display-only, old allowances without it retain the typed ladder

counted.description: On allowance only, added 2026-10-04 (ruling 109 2 (a)): a trading key's bot, what the cycle entering now counts against the key's 24 hours (its ladder at the bot's last price, in USDC). Absent for a bot no key created.

keyOver.description: On allowance only, added 2026-10-04 (ruling 109 2 (a)): the trading key's limits leave no room for this cycle; nothing is sent and the bot waits in repair key-limit. An older build reading it would enter the cycle; it never has such a bot.

against.description: On allowance only, added 2026-10-04 (ruling 172 (b)): a trading key's bot, the size the account holds on the other side of the cycle entering now, read with the allowance; its orders reduce it (one position per coin and account) and the bot reports it once. Absent when none. An older build ignores it.

marginMode.description: MH 2026-10-25, M1: mode read with allowance/leverage, selecting the recorded account-sizing factor; absent preserves previous arithmetic

leverage.description: On allowance and leverage inputs (d100(b)), added 2026-10-17 (MH 623 (c)-(e)): a perpetual bot whose stop is the expected loss (settings slLossPct), the account's leverage on the coin, read with the allowance; the cycle entering now works its stop out at it and keeps it. Absent when not read, and for every other bot: the cycle's stop is then the bot's slPct. An older build ignores it.

on.description: On pause only: true pauses, false resumes.

cause.description: Differs and correction carry their own cause (described above). On released, added 2026-10-10 (0003b amendment 3 d2, ruling 413.4): the bot's account was removed from gcx; the bot ends done error, its row's `released` account. Absent, as every older row: done stopped. An older build ignores it (done stopped).

kind.description: On liquidation only, added 2026-10-05 (decision 0016 Amendment 3 d5): the fill was the exchange's auto-deleveraging; the bot ends done (adl). Absent: a liquidation, as every older row. Its `size` is the bot's share of the fill (held over the exchange's position), as it always was the amount charged.

fee.description: On liquidation only, added 2026-10-05 (decision 0016 Amendment 3 d2): the bot's share of the fill's fee in quote (fee × share ÷ the sum of the sizes every party was charged, the bots' and the person's; on one side fee × share ÷ fill; MH ruling 226 a), booked into its realized PnL and fees. Absent: none, as every older row. An older build ignores it.

coinFee.description: On create only, added 2026-10-03 (ruling 151): on a spot pair whose buys pay their fee in the coin bought, the account's spot taker rate as a fraction, read when the bot was created (the venue's highest standard rate, Hyperliquid 0.0007, when the read failed); the bot's fee top-up is on from its first entry, and the first fill's own rate takes over. Absent (perpetuals, and every create written before): the top-up is off until a fill shows a fee in the coin.

oneOf.title: Notification switches
oneOf.description: The bot's notification switches (decision 0009 d2): stops, TP and SL fills, entry and averaging fills from a level.

oneOf.title: A difference the person knows about
oneOf.description: 'I know why' on the line 'Bot · Exchange' (catalogue Q8): the exchange's size then; the line stays quiet until the difference grows past it.
